prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, restyle of an existing game location. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot of the Mega Park, a large skate park set into a forested valley of the island in the game Yorimichi, seen from the western hills with the volcano on the left. Image 2 is another place in the same game and shows the art direction to match: soft painterly low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, pale lavender-grey rocks, autumn maples and ginkgos in rust, orange and gold, dark green pines, soft green grass, a clean blue sky. Repaint image 1 as the AFTER concept from exactly the same camera and composition. Every skating structure stays exactly as it is, in the same place with the same shape: the concrete decks, ramps, bowls, retaining walls, stairs, rails, the grandstand building and the big roll-in. Only the scenery changes: the red desert sandstone cliffs, hoodoos and grey rock peaks become weathered volcanic rock in the island's lavender-grey, still rugged, layered and blocky like Mount Myogi in Japan, with moss, ferns and small autumn maples rooted in the ledges; the thin dead-looking poles, cacti and desert shrubs become the island's autumn trees and pines; the pale scrubland ground becomes the same soft green grass with fallen leaves as the hills around; the white SHARKS letters become a large weathered wooden sign board with a few Japanese characters. Keep the concrete pale and weathered. Keep the park rugged, with a raw skate-spot character, but make it look like it was always part of this island. No people, no UI, no labels.
